title: Broad Haven students draw silver disc

tellings.quote: Broad Haven, UK, 10 students. see a silver disc. They draw pictures. They're identical.

plain: Ten students at Broad Haven in Britain are said to have seen a silver disc and then drawn pictures of it that came out identical. Marik von Rennenkampff mentions it briefly, without a source, in a challenge to the UFO skeptic Mick West on Michels's show, as a case where several witnesses agree on what they saw.
